about.text: In this appeal from the grant of a preliminary injunction, we are asked to decide whether two Georgia campaign-finance statutes violate the First Amendment and, as a threshold matter, whether the district court should have abstained from exercising its jurisdiction under Younger v. Harris, 401 U.S. 37 (1971).
